description: This file implements the Shutdown class for the 'generic' task namespace within the Rialto server project. It defines the constructor, destructor, and execute method for shutting down a media player, including logging statements.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the shutdown process of a media player within the Rialto server's generic tasks namespace.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown object with a reference to the IGstGenericPlayerPrivate interface.

methods.name: ~Shutdown
methods.description: Destructor that logs the shutdown completion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the shutdown operation by stopping the worker thread of the media player.
